subject: Discovery -> Trial: POC runbook & milestones for Voyager AI
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.w@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@voyager.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 15:15:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery -> Trial: POC runbook & milestones for Voyager AI

Hi Priya / Aman,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciated the detail on the ingestion pipeline and the latency constraints.

Quick recap + proposed POC scope (TL;DR):

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference latency/cost at Voyager's 10k monthly active requests pattern and confirm prompt-safety/PII redaction pipeline.
- Success criteria (please confirm):
  * 95th percentile generation latency <= 350ms for 512-token responses
  * End-to-end cost estimate within 40% of our baseline target
  * No unexpected data exfiltration; telemetry + audit logs visible in Console
  * Model quality: >= 85% acceptance rate on your internal evaluation set
- Proposed POC structure:
  1) Week 0 (kickoff, environment setup) — provision sandbox project, access tokens
  2) Week 1 (ingest sample data + baseline tests) — run 10k simulated requests
  3) Week 2 (integration + functional sign-off) — iterate on prompts & filters
  4) Week 3-4 (scale soak + final metrics & handoff)

Owners (Redwood):
- Logan Wright — commercial lead / overall timeline
- Marissa Cole — solutions engineering / integration
- Marcus Lin — infra + provisioning (GPU pools)

Ask: can you confirm the success criteria above and whether the suggested cadence works? If so we'll lock a kickoff on Nov 8 and share the POC Runbook + checklist.

Attachments: Voyager_POC_Runbook_v1.xlsx (scope + milestone checklist), Redwood_POC_Checklist.pdf (security & access checklist)

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
logan.w@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Priya Desai <priya@voyager.ai>

Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 17:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery -> Trial: POC runbook & milestones for Voyager AI

Logan — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:

- Success criteria: broadly agree with the KPIs. We will validate model quality with a 1k-sample labeled set (I can share labels) and confirm acceptance thresholds internally.
- Two items to confirm before kickoff:
  1) Data residency: For POC we need logs and telemetry retained in our US tenant and not forwarded to third-party analytics outside the US.
  2) Integration checklist: we need a short list of required endpoints and credentials (S3 paths, webhook endpoints) — can you share that?

If you can address the two points, Nov 8 works for a kickoff. I'll loop in our infra lead if needed.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Desai
Head of ML Ops, Voyager AI
priya@voyager.ai | +1 212-555-0199

Thanks Priya — good callouts. Quick responses and updated plan: 

1) Data residency / telemetry: For the POC we can host telemetry (Console logs, traces, and audit exports) in your US tenant only — we'll disable cross-region analytics and ensure export hooks point to your S3. I'll put the exact config steps in the Runbook.

2) Integration checklist (short):
  - S3 sample data location + read credentials (IAM role or short-term keys)
  - API endpoint(s) for sanity checks (internal test harness)
  - Webhook callback URL for async notifications (optional)
  - Blocklist/allowlist for outbound telemetry endpoints (we'll provide a CIDR list)

Proposed timeline with dates (assuming kickoff Nov 8):
  - Nov 8 (Mon) — Kickoff + access provisioning
  - Nov 9–15 — Sample ingest + baseline runs (Marissa leads)
  - Nov 16–22 — Integration + functional sign-off (iterate prompts/filters)
  - Nov 23–29 — Scale soak + final metrics report (Marcus leads infra tests)
  - Nov 30 — Handoff & decision checkpoint

Owners (confirmed):
  - Logan Wright (commercial) — schedule and acceptance checkpoint
  - Marissa Cole (solutions eng) — integration and tests
  - Marcus Lin (infra) — GPU provisioning and load testing

I'll upload an updated Runbook to the Drive and add the checklist items you asked for: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1abcPOCdoc. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567.

If that looks good I'll schedule the 30-minute kickoff on Nov 8 (30-min window: 10:00–10:30 PT).

—Logan
